scope: CDN: full sample refresh, HTTP plus disk cache reads/checks/writes, no Arrow decoding/routing. API: public IRail.get_connections, HTTP plus JSON/model parsing, shared session, ETag support enabled, no retries. API primes and one-second pacing excluded from warm medians. Response body bytes exclude HTTP headers and TLS; API aiohttp bytes may be decompressed. CDN variants share the same disk cache, prime before measurement, and create a fresh session per refresh. aiohttp reuses connections within each refresh; urllib is the original baseline.
